opencode_pool.note: 2026-10-16: shared pool across all models. Go calibrated against user dashboard (82% 5h, 90% week) and local spend ($9.70/$26.46). Go Plus is an unverified 4x estimate.

dashboard.note: User's OpenCode Go dashboard reading after the weekly reset and new API key. Update with each new reading; hx uses it until each window rolls past it.

routing_order_note: 2026-11-06 creator decision: perform implementation work on OpenCode (deepseek-v4.1-flash first on the ladder) and use free Devin SWE-2 only when the OpenCode pool is spent. Put "devin" first to ask for Devin explicitly.

thresholds.pool_soft_limit_note: 2026-10-17 owner directive: spend all OpenCode allowance before falling back to Codex (was 0.85); 0.98 keeps a margin because spend is estimated.

ladders_note: 2026-10-22 owner directive, temporary: glm-5.3-flash demoted to last in every ladder and replaced as the persistent model after repeated stalls and a context overrun in real work (portfolio project); revisit after the next benchmark. 2026-11-06 creator executive decision: deepseek-v4.1-flash is the go-to model, first in every ladder and the persistent OpenCode model (Global regions enabled; smoke test passed).
opencode_variants_note: Declared --variant choices per model from opencode models --verbose (2026-10-16). glm-5.3-flash ignores an effort that is not one of these; route/ocrun must not send it.

excluded_models.deepseek-v4-pro: untested; Global regions are now enabled (2026-11-06), benchmark before use
excluded_models.minimax-m3: Exhausts its fixed 32K reasoning budget with ~no output on multi-file edits after ~35K context: 4 of 6 real tasks on 2026-10-16 (docs/FINDINGS.md 7, 9). No variants to lower it.

context_limits_note: Effective worker limits for compaction decisions, capped at 200K: every call re-sends the context as cached input, so cost pressure arrives long before the native window (opencode models --verbose, 2026-10-16: 1M for most, 262144 for kimi-k2.7-code).

context.claude_lead_note: Compact at a boundary around 240K tokens (0.6 of the 400K effective lead limit). The native window is 1M, but every turn re-reads the cached context, so cost and attention pressure start well before the window is full.

promo.source: https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/models: 'SWE-2 is free for self-serve plans in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI through November 30, 2026; it does not apply to Devin cloud sessions.' devin models list tags swe-2-medium/high/max cost_tier Free (Devin Pro, CLI 3000.11.234).
promo.note: No timezone is published, so free routing ends at the end of 30 Nov in UTC+14 (the earliest reading). After that, or if the live model list stops tagging the model Free, hx refuses Devin runs. Extending ends_at needs renewed pricing verification and the user's approval.

devin.note: 2026-11-06 creator decision: OpenCode with deepseek-v4.1-flash first is the go-to implementation worker; free Devin SWE-2 is the fallback when the OpenCode pool is exhausted or the caller puts devin first in routing_order. Lightning variants are paid and never allowed. models maps hx effort to a SWE-2 id: high by default, max for hard work; dispatch swe-2-medium by hand when latency matters.
devin.max_concurrent_note: 2026-10-31: two concurrent runs measured (separate repos, both ok on swe-2-high, no throttling); a third was refused busy. Raise only after measuring; parallel runs still need disjoint files or worktrees.
